paper.Fry a sliced onion in 20g butter until soft, add 400g drained sauerkraut and 1 tsp caraway seeds and warm through for 10 minutes.Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered.Steam 8 hot dog buns over the simmering water for 1 minute.Fill each bun with a frank, a line of yellow mustard and a spoon of the kraut.Wrap each in baking paper to serve.MainsMae's rich gravy made from the pan juices.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 100ml hot milk.Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes, then flip, add 40g butter and thyme
